record_scope_reconstruction: Farmers restricted freight on Hrebenne, Dorohusk, Zosin and Dołhobyczów approaches; Dołhobyczów has two episodes separated by Easter suspension. At Dorohusk the police identify Okopy DK12/DW816 junction, not the checkpoint gate.

source_checks.finding: Police notice identifies Hrebenne DK17, Dorohusk approach at Okopy DK12/DW816, Dołhobyczów, and Zosin suspension March21 20:00. Authorized future protest dates do not prove continuous obstruction.
